stem: An Aurora MySQL cluster's read traffic has grown enough that the team wants to add several more low-latency readers that share the primary's storage, with new readers picked up automatically by the application's existing connection string.

choices.text: Create standalone RDS read replicas of the cluster's engine and connect to each one directly
Enable a Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment with two additional readable standbys
Add Aurora Replicas to the cluster and connect the application through the reader endpoint
Promote one of the existing Aurora Replicas to a standalone writer instance

rationale: Aurora Replicas share the primary's underlying storage, and the cluster's reader endpoint automatically load-balances connections across whichever replicas are currently available, so the application never needs reconfiguring as replicas are added. Standalone RDS read replicas do not share Aurora's cluster storage and would need the application to track each endpoint on its own. A Multi-AZ DB cluster caps out at two readable standbys, short of the several more readers asked for here, and is a different deployment type from adding replicas to an existing Aurora cluster. Promoting a replica to a standalone writer removes it from the reader pool instead of adding read capacity.
